|gr1= GUI Control - ListBox

|descr= Sets the additional value in the row with the given index of a [[CT_LISTBOX]] or [[CT_COMBO]] control.

|p2= index: [[Number]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|p21= control: [[Control]]
